newsitem.title: USA: Insituform has definitive pact on changes.
newsitem.headline: Insituform has definitive pact on changes.

text.p: Insituform Technologies Inc said Friday it reached a definitive agreement on a previously announced settlement of a dispute over corporate governance issues.
The company has agreed to reduce the size of its board to nine from 13 members and eliminate staggered terms for directors, among other things, it said.
The agreement was part of negotiations with a group led by two directors, Jerome Kalishman and Robert Affholder, the company said.

"We are satisfied that this agreement resolves the company's corporate governance issues and allows us to avoid a costly and and time-consuming proxy fight," Chief Executive Anthony Hooper and Kalishman said in a joint statement.
"We are committed to moving forward to implement the company's restructuring plan and improving profitability."
